23/**
24 * @brief Interface for loading bot data from an abstract source. Implementations provide the
25 * concrete I/O strategy (e.g., local filesystem, in-memory assets).
26 *
27 * @note See @ref FileBotLoader and SuperDexStudioBotLoader for file- and memory-based examples,
28 * respectively.
29 * @note Pass an @ref IBotLoader to @ref superdex::robotics::LoadBotPrefab to control how files and
30 * shapes are resolved.
31 */
32struct MOCHI_API IBotLoader {
33 virtual ~IBotLoader() = default;
34
35 /**
36 * @brief Determine the @ref BotFileType of a Mochi Bot source.
37 * @param[in] path Abstract path to the Mochi Bot source.
38 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Check @ref Error::IsOK for success.
39 * @return The detected @ref BotFileType. Do not use the result if @p error is set.
40 */
41 virtual BotFileType GetBotFileType(std::string_view path, superdex::Error& error) const = 0;
42
43 /**
44 * @brief Load flat @ref BotPrefab from a Mochi Bot source.
45 *
46 * @param[in] path Abstract path to the Mochi Bot source.
47 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Check @ref Error::IsOK for success.
48 * @return Loaded @ref BotPrefab, or default-constructed on failure.
49 *
50 * @note Implementations MUST call @ref RebuildBotData before returning BotPrefab!
51 */
52 virtual BotPrefab LoadBotPrefab(std::string_view path, superdex::Error& error) const = 0;
53
54 /**
55 * @brief Load @ref ModBotPrefab from a Mochi Bot source.
56 *
57 * @param[in] path Abstract path to the Mochi Bot source.
58 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Check @ref Error::IsOK for success.
59 * @return Loaded @ref ModBotPrefab, or default-constructed on failure.
60 */
61 virtual ModBotPrefab LoadModBotPrefab(std::string_view path, superdex::Error& error) const = 0;
62
63 /**
64 * @brief Load a Mochi shape from a model resource.
65 *
66 * @param[in] path File path to the shape asset.
67 * @param[in] bakeScale Scale to bake into the shape geometry.
68 * @param[in] bakeTransform Transform to bake into the shape geometry.
69 * @param[in] context Mochi context used to create the shape.
70 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Check @ref Error::IsOK for success.
71 * @return Handle to the loaded shape, or invalid handle on failure.
72 */
73 virtual ShapeHandle LoadShape(
74 std::string_view path,
75 Real3 const& bakeScale,
76 TransformRT const& bakeTransform,
77 Context* context,
78 superdex::Error& error) const = 0;
79};
80
81/**
82 * @brief Default file-system implementation of @ref IBotLoader. Loads @ref BotPrefab and @ref
83 * ModBotPrefab from .superdex_bot files and shape assets from .mochi.h5 models directly from the
84 * local filesystem.
85 */
86struct MOCHI_API FileBotLoader : IBotLoader {
87 ~FileBotLoader() override = default;
88 BotFileType GetBotFileType(std::string_view path, superdex::Error& error) const override;
89 BotPrefab LoadBotPrefab(std::string_view path, superdex::Error& error) const override;
90 ModBotPrefab LoadModBotPrefab(std::string_view path, superdex::Error& error) const override;
91 ShapeHandle LoadShape(
92 std::string_view path,
93 Real3 const& bakeScale,
94 TransformRT const& bakeTransform,
95 Context* context,
96 superdex::Error& error) const override;
97};
98
99/**
100 * @brief Load bot parameters from an abstract source using a custom loader (e.g. SuperDexStudio,
101 * Unreal). If the path refers to a @ref ModBotPrefab, the mod bot recipe is evaluated to
102 * produce the final @ref BotPrefab. Otherwise, the parameters are loaded directly.
103 *
104 * @param[in] path File path to the .superdex_bot file.
105 * @param[in] loader Loader used to read files and shapes.
106 * @param[in] validate If true, the bot will be validated on load. If it is a built-bot it will be
107 * validated after each modification stage.
108 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Check @ref Error::IsOK for success.
109 * @return Loaded or built @ref BotPrefab, or default-constructed on failure.
110 */
111MOCHI_API BotPrefab LoadBotPrefab(
112 std::string_view path,
113 IBotLoader const& loader,
114 bool validate,
115 superdex::Error& error);
116
117} // namespace superdex::robotics
